skill.description: ** Audits a `package-lock.json` (lockfileVersion 2/3) against the live npm registry BEFORE `npm install`. PR-diff mode audits only what a lockfile change introduces. 3 tools: `audit_lockfile`, `check_install_scripts`, `verify_integrity`. MIT-licensed.
